description: This Java class defines an immutable command object for recording single debit or credit journal entry actions in the Fineract accounting module. It encapsulates account ID, amount, comments, and tracks which parameters were passed in a request.

classes.name: SingleDebitOrCreditEntryCommand
classes.description: Immutable command class encapsulating details for a single debit or credit journal entry, with methods to check if specific fields were changed.

methods.name: isGlAccountIdChanged
methods.description: Checks if the glAccountId parameter was included in the request.

methods.name: isGlAmountChanged
methods.description: Checks if the amount parameter was included in the request.

methods.name: isCommentsChanged
methods.description: Checks if the comments parameter was included in the request.
